faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) post at Ordnance Factory Ambarnath is 09-10-2026.

faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) position will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 45000 per month.

faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Degree from a recognized University/Institute and a Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Social Work, Social Science, Labour Welfare, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, or an MBA in Personnel Management or Human Resource Management.

faq.answer: The age limit for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) post is between 27 years and 45 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the LWO post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) post will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the LWO post?
